verdict.rationale: Salesforce's own marketing says Sales Cloud can deploy AI agents that run 24/7 to autonomously handle repetitive tasks, and it lists built-in Sales Flows and Lead Routing. A community user also reports setting up a timed email in SFDC within minutes. The evidence is mostly marketing-level, though, and does not document how background automations are configured, triggered, or scheduled. missing for 10: first-party documentation of automation setup (triggers, recurring schedules, background execution model), operational limits and monitoring of autonomous runs, and independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous agent automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Deploy AI agents 24/7 to autonomously handle repetitive tasks, expand your pipeline, and boost revenue without adding headcount.
